body:
## Context

Parallel groups will run two `runWorkDriver` calls concurrently in one process. Module-global inventory shows non-concurrency-safe state: the work-widget singleton (`activeCtx`/`lastIssue`/`stepStartedAt`/`tickHandle` + single `STATUS_KEY`, work-widget.ts:29-50,133-169) — one group's `clear()` kills the other's cursor; `spawnSpecialist` (spawn.ts:385) has no global child cap, and lens-review's direct `Promise.all` fanout (lens-review.ts:300,361) bypasses async-jobs throttling entirely — two groups' lens-review = 12 simultaneous children plus develop fanout. Driver `sendUserMessage` calls (work-driver.ts:5209-5213) and lifecycle events (lifecycle-events.ts:187-202) carry no cycle attribution; `/work-status` (work-status.ts:78-79) auto-picks one state file.

These guards must land before concurrency is switched on. This work must ship as its own separate PR, independent of any other open issue.

## What to build

**A. Global spawn semaphore** in `spawnSpecialist` (spawn.ts:385): module-level counter + FIFO queue; default cap 8, `PI_ENSEMBLE_SPAWN_CAP` override (`=0` semantics: unlimited/disabled). Both the async-jobs path and the direct lens/adversarial `Promise.all` paths (lens-review.ts:300,361) flow through it. Excess queues FIFO, never throws.

**B. work-widget multiplexing** (work-widget.ts:29-50,133-169): replace singleton fields with `Map<issue, CycleView>`; single `STATUS_KEY` renders a composite line, one segment per active cycle; `clear(issue)` removes one segment, clears the key only when the map empties.

**C. Cycle attribution:** thread `issue` into `emitStep*` (lifecycle-events.ts:187-202) and dispatch-deck row labels; prefix driver `sendUserMessage` calls (work-driver.ts:5209-5213) with `[#N]`.

**D. `/work-status`** (work-status.ts:78-79): list all state files with a running status instead of auto-picking one.

**E. Jittered lens retry backoff** (lens-review.ts:327): `1000 + rand(0..500)`ms.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fake-`spawn` test: 12-way burst never exceeds cap concurrent children; queued spawns all complete in FIFO order; direct lens `Promise.all` path is capped too.
- [ ] Widget unit test: two cycles update and clear independently; key cleared only when both done; single-cycle rendering unchanged.
- [ ] Lifecycle events and user messages carry `[#N]` for multi-cycle runs; single-cycle output visually unchanged.
- [ ] `/work-status` lists multiple running cycles.
- [ ] `PI_ENSEMBLE_SPAWN_CAP=0` disables the semaphore.
- [ ] tsc + biome + smokes green; docs updated (env-knob table).

## Out of scope

Parallel group queue itself; integration mutex; token-budget accounting; raising default caps; any work-driver step logic.

## Test plan

Offline: semaphore burst test; widget two-cycle test; `/work-status` multi-state fixture. Live on a measured cycle: run one `/work` cycle and confirm widget/status/attribution behavior is unchanged in the single-cycle case.

---

---

## Note (2026-07-29) — reliability investigation: load ruled out as failure mechanism

The 2026-07-29 root-cause investigation into the "endpoint sporadically failing" regression **ruled out spawn concurrency/load** as a failure mechanism: max 7 simultaneous children observed, TTFT p50 7s / p90 15s with no correlation between concurrency and failures (both errored children died at concurrency ≤1). The spawn semaphore remains valid engineering for the parallel-groups scale-up (#289) but is **not** a reliability fix — prioritize the reliability series (#295–#300) ahead of this issue.
title: feat(concurrency): global spawn semaphore, multi-cycle work-widget, cycle attribution, jittered lens backoff
